description: Positions in the change stream, the revisions a consumer reads after a position, and retention. A position P means every revision with sequence <= P has been applied.

position_checks.name: just before two revisions become available together
position_checks.reason: The last revision available by then is the May 2025 withdrawal.

position_checks.name: two revisions with the same available_at
position_checks.reason: The June 2025 release (19) and the May 2025 re-release (20) share available_at; the position includes both.

position_checks.name: export snapshot time
position_checks.reason: rev_aug26_1 is the last available revision; rev_aug26_2 is not available until 12:30:40.

read_checks.name: withdrawal, then a tie in available_at
read_checks.reason: Revisions are read in sequence order. Sequence, not available_at, orders 19 and 20.

read_checks.name: revision delivered before the release it revises
read_checks.reason: Delivery order differs from precedence for obs_nov25.

read_checks.name: provider correction
read_checks.reason: A correction is its own revision; the erroneous revision stays in the history.

read_checks.name: end of the stream
read_checks.reason: No revisions follow the last one.

apply_checks.name: apply by precedence, not arrival
apply_checks.reason: A consumer that overwrites its current value with each event in delivery order ends on rev_nov25_1 (100.0). Keeping the revision with the highest revision_number leaves rev_nov25_2 (100.2).

scenarios.name: an event is retained until 1,095 days after it became available
scenarios.reason: The first event became available at 2024-02-03T12:31:10Z and expires 1,095 days later, at 2027-02-02T12:31:10Z. One second before, position 0 can still continue.

scenarios.name: a position expires when the next event is past retention
scenarios.reason: At the instant the first event expires, a consumer at position 0 must load a fresh snapshot instead of skipping ahead. Position 1 still continues, because event 2 is retained.

scenarios.name: a caught-up position does not expire
scenarios.reason: A consumer at the head has nothing to read, however old the events are. One behind the head, it needs event 37, which is past retention by 2030.

scenarios.name: a position ahead of the stream is refused
scenarios.reason: At the export snapshot time the head is 36. Position 37 can only come from a later clock, before a reset.

scenarios.name: events that share an available_at arrive together
scenarios.reason: Revisions 19 and 20 became available at the same instant; the clock reveals both, and sequence orders them.
